summary: Iteration 4 testing complete. Backend: 32/32 pytest passing (24 regression + 8 new for proof-photo + business/me + business/shipments CRUD + express 1.5x earnings). Frontend: welcome screen (role-driver/role-business) → role-business persists & redirects to /business ✓; / with business role auto-redirects to /business ✓; business-home shows welcome card + new-shipment-button + switch-to-driver + empty state ✓; 3-step new shipment form (pickup-name/pickup-address/dropoff-address → customer-name/customer-phone/customer-apt/customer-notes → item-name/item-qty + priority-standard/priority-express) submits via POST /api/business/shipments and routes to /business/track?id=… with track-shipment-screen showing STAGES list + DISTANCE/ETA/COST meta row ✓; settings theme-light/system/dark all present and clickable, Dark highlighted in primary color when selected ✓; switch-role-business persists business + routes to /business ✓; sign-out clears @nadaruns/role and lands on /welcome (verified via reload of / → /welcome) ✓; driver order at arrived_dropoff shows open-photo-proof-button which opens photo-proof-modal with proof-camera + proof-gallery testIDs ✓.

ui_bugs.issue: Stats card (Total/Active/Delivered) is rendered visually but the testID 'statsCard' from the spec is NOT present on the wrapping View. Probed variants statsCard, stats-card, stat-total, stat-active, stat-delivered — none match. Add testID='statsCard' to the stats container if test contracts depend on it.

issues: Carry-over RN-Web warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated → use 'boxShadow'; 'Image: style.resizeMode deprecated → use props.resizeMode'. Non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: (Carryover) react-native-maps still in plugins array → logs PluginError on Metro start. Non-blocking on web.

action_items: (Optional) Add testID='statsCard' on the business-home stats container so the spec's testID contract matches.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/orders/{id}/proof correctly persists proof_photo (base64 data URL) and returns updated Order. 404 on missing order ✓.

POST /api/business/shipments computes haversine distance correctly with min 0.5km clamp; earnings formula base = 6 + 2.4*distance; express multiplier = 1.5x; eta express adds 5 min vs standard 10 min — verified 1.5x ratio holds in tests.
GET /api/business/me auto-refreshes total_shipments via count_documents — derived stat, no stale data risk.
Frontend role storage uses AsyncStorage (IndexedDB on web), key '@nadaruns/role'. clearRole() correctly removes it; UI test confirmed sign-out → /welcome and / reload also stays on /welcome.
index.tsx role-gating runs inside useFocusEffect→load — redirects work on every focus, so role switches propagate immediately (verified switch-to-driver → /, switch-role-business → /business).
PhotoProofModal correctly exposed at arrived_dropoff state above SwipeToConfirm; testIDs proof-camera/proof-gallery present and modal opens on tap.
Backend Order.business_id is optional; driver-seeded orders leave it null, business-created orders set it to 'business-001' → clean separation for /api/business/shipments listing.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all iter4 testIDs + flows verified; one missing testID statsCard reported as low-prio)

seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_ shipments via POST /api/business/shipments during tests (left in DB — they belong to business-001 and only affect total_shipments count). Photo proof uploaded to one test order. None of this affects driver-flow regression tests.
